Your notes are the starting point. Ivy helps you notice what needs another look.

  1. Spot uncertainty signalsQuestion marks, “idk,” “I don’t know,” “confused,” and similar phrases.
  2. Take one hintTry a guiding question tied to the exact line before opening an explanation.
  3. Check clarity tooWhen you write “I get it,” Ivy can ask you to prove it with an example.

Connect your Firebase project
This prototype works locally now. To enable cloud saving and real AI reviews:
  1. Create a Firebase project and register a web app.
  2. Enable Authentication → Anonymous and create a Firestore database.
  3. Enable Firebase AI Logic → Gemini Developer API and register App Check.
  4. Copy your web app configuration and App Check site key into dist/config.js.
  5. Publish the included firestore.rules, then restart or refresh the app.
The project’s README has the full beginner walkthrough. Never put private keys in the app.
Anonymous accounts belong to this browser. Clearing browser data can remove access to cloud notebooks; download important work. Use permanent sign-in before a student rollout.
